g.text: on 2E it is the root selector of the halving inside the odd-order subgroup

g.text: Tr(a) = 0, Tr(b) = 1 (v = 2, Z/4): pair (Tr(x), b₂), b₂ = Tr(y) + Tr(x·H(x+a)), β = Tr(b·H(b))

g.text: b₃(R) = b₂(R/2) for even R (either half); b₃(P) = b₃(P+Q0) for odd P. Level J: (bit1, b₂(S₁), …, b₂(S_{J-1})), S_{i+1} = half(S_i or S_i+Q0).

g.text: Measured: all four of E/4E, E/8E, E/16E, E/32E labels match this table (v ≥ 2, 3, 4, 5); see evidence figure.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: L is a set bijection E/2^J E → F₂^J, not a group map (Z/2^J has no injective additive map into F₂^J, J ≥ 2).
